title: Auto Party Accept
description: Automatically accepts Hypixel party invites from whitelisted players with simple /apa commands
body:
## Auto Party Accept
### Features
Automatically accepts Hypixel party invites from whitelisted players.
Detects invite messages in chat/system messages.
Case-insensitive whitelist stored in `config/autopartyaccept/whitelist.txt`.
### Commands
- `/apa add <name1> <name2> ...` (also supports comma-separated names)
- `/apa del <name>`
- `/apa list`
- `/apa clear`
### Notes
Client-side only.
Requires Fabric API.
